countdown.title: Your account is scheduled for deletion
countdown.body_one: It will be deleted in {{count}} day, on {{date}}. You can cancel until then.
countdown.body_other: It will be deleted in {{count}} days, on {{date}}. You can cancel until then.
countdown.inProgressBody: The grace period has ended and deletion has started. It can no longer be cancelled.
countdown.tooLate: Deletion has already started, so it can't be cancelled now.

analytics.title: Product analytics
analytics.body: Anonymous usage events help us improve the app. They never include health values, food names, notes or children's details.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.body: You can withdraw optional consents at any time. Terms and the privacy policy end only by deleting your account.

effects.marketing: You will stop receiving news and offers. Nothing else changes.
effects.ai_processing: The assistant, meal photo analysis and AI plan changes stop working until you agree again. The app will ask next time you open it.
effects.health_data: Health-based planning stops until you agree again, and the app will ask next time you open it. Your saved data stays until you delete it.
effects.child_data: Children's profiles in this household can't be updated until you agree again. Their saved data stays until you delete it.

export.title: Download my data
export.body: We prepare a file with everything you can see in the app and email you a link that works for 24 hours. For your security, we may ask for a code first.
export.sent: Requested. Check your email for the download link; it works for 24 hours.

deleteCard.title: Delete account
deleteCard.body: Permanently delete your account and data after a 30-day grace period.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Your account will be deleted after {{days}} days. Until then you can still sign in and cancel.

whatGoes.family: Family members you added, in households you own alone
whatGoes.health: Health profiles, growth records and food tries
whatGoes.logs: Meal, water, fasting and weight logs

delete.households: If you own a household with other members, make one of them the owner first.
delete.subscriptions: Store subscriptions aren't cancelled automatically. Manage them in the App Store or Google Play.
delete.reasonHint: This helps us improve. It is not required.
delete.reauthAgain: That took a little long. Please confirm with a new code.
delete.transferBody: You own {{households}}, which has other members. Make someone else the owner in household settings, then try again.
delete.subscriptionWarning: You still have an active store subscription. Cancel it in the App Store or Google Play so you aren't charged.
